scope: Eight-step, source-owned business journey spanning account/auth and a rejected statistics request, with real nonempty remote/data. The request boundary receives explicitly supplied, already verified post-auth contexts. OAuth issuance, token introspection and startup are outside this profile. Source JSON binding/serialization callbacks remain inside the profile. This is not a full-stack OAuth or whole-application oracle.

execution_environment.http: healthy transport and source-selected service destinations; no timeout, service discovery failure, retries or open circuit preventing a declared request

execution_environment.startup: complete before journey; no static/bean initialization is part of edge oracle

framework_contract.configuration: Pinned repository shared configuration; no deployment overrides that disable Hystrix or alter JSON/validation/security. Hystrix is on classpath, enabled=true, statistics client fallback is a component, no per-client vanilla Feign.Builder.

json.engine: Spring Boot default Jackson2 bean binding, with public source setters/getters invoked
json.unknown_properties: ignored by Boot default FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES=false; do not rely on the legacy org.codehaus.jackson annotation being recognized by Jackson2
json.null_inclusion: Default inclusion preserves null object properties
json.date_normalization: $instant means parse emitted ISO Date representation and require the exact instant, not any string, not arbitrary U. No claim of exact JSON byte formatting.
json.decimal_normalization: JSON numeric values compared as exact BigDecimal numeric values; nested DTO declared types are still required
json.projection_order: Property order is not specified; callback sets checked per trigger, not invented total getter order

framework_contract.binding_and_validation: Deserialize source bean first; field-based @Valid constraints then reject statistics incomes=null with MethodArgumentNotValidException/400 before handler. Binding callbacks still execute. Missing required RequestBody produces HttpMessageNotReadableException/400 before handler, with no DTO instance.
framework_contract.feign: POST/PUT request bodies use SpringEncoder; consumes APPLICATION_JSON_UTF8_VALUE yields application/json;charset=UTF-8. Default non-2xx error decoder throws. Hystrix statistics fallback returns normally; auth has no fallback and propagates failure (possibly wrapped).
framework_contract.events_and_edges: executes contains reached source methods, including public JSON callbacks and fallback. calls contains source-to-source method invocations; framework callback roots have trigger events, not fabricated caller->getter/setter calls. remote is added at entered remote handler, not request send; no statistics remote edge on binding validation reject. data is source method->logical collection and deduplicated within step.
framework_contract.persistence: Logical persistent Java fields, using declared field access. Mongo _id is Account.name or User.username. _class/internal BSON storage bytes are not the measured view. Each completed repository.save is an independent successful write; no source @Transactional spans the HTTP call.

acceptance_scope: This document is an independently reviewed source oracle for the eight-step business slice under explicit boundaries. It is not a passed analyzer run, not acceptance of missing additional cases, not general portability proof, and not an OAuth implementation test.

edge_projection_contract.rule: Exclude source getters reached only by library reflection from exported executes/calls. Keep their semantic callbacks and values. A method also reached by explicit Java code stays in projected edges. This is provenance-sensitive, not a name-based get* filter.
edge_projection_contract.semantic_edges: Exactly the frozen v2 edge contract. It is not the complete JVM event graph and does not gain reflected constructors or new library methods.
edge_projection_contract.edges: Projected organizers-format edge sets. Only reflection-only getter executes/calls change in this source profile; wire, state, arguments, uncertainties and preconditions are copied unchanged.
edge_projection_contract.reflection_edges: All reflected getter roots represented by v2, including a method ID also reached by source code. This records suppressed callback roots, not a disjoint set difference. Calls are empty here because v2 never fabricated framework->getter source calls.
edge_projection_contract.reconstruction: For every edge kind: union(edges,reflection_edges)==semantic_edges. projection_difference.removed_edges is the disjoint difference. Duplicate method IDs across roles are intentional.
edge_projection_contract.setters: REFERENCE:64 names reflected getters and constructors, not setters. Source setter roots already in v2 remain projected. This review does not invent a broader all-reflection exclusion.
edge_projection_contract.constructors: Do not restore or add reflected constructor edges when reconstructing v2. DTO classes here have no declared constructor symbols in the frozen v2 maps. No source constructor callback expectation is invented from implicit allocation.
edge_projection_contract.other_framework_roots: Source ControllerAdvice and Hystrix fallback methods remain semantic and projected; they are not getters. No fabricated source caller edges are introduced.
edge_projection_contract.semantic_callbacks: Source method/role/trigger/result/outcome and declaration evidence retained separately from export policy. Callback existence is not inferred from absence/presence of projected method IDs.

framework_contract_scope: Unmodified v2 semantic execution/library contract. For exported edges the explicit v3 edge_projection_contract overrides only projection, not semantics or preconditions.
